text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After spending day after day chasing
dreams with
Bamboo Memory, our first
three years together
are coming to an
end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But this isn't the end of her dream
chasing. In
fact, we've yet to even see a
glimpse of the end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Because as long as people hold dreams
in their
hearts...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure they'll continue to talk about
Bamboo
Memory's powerful running and
how it shines light
upon everyone's
dreams.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
They've crossed the 600-meter mark
and rounded
the final turn! Now they're
onto the final stretch!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O and Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo and Yaeno
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
100 meters left! Here they come! And
she's
crossed the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wheeew! Now that's what I call a
red-hot race!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, my heart was aflutter the whole
time.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno! You were even more powerful
than usual
today!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you got something real good
out of
that bout with your grandpa!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You might be right.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the day I managed to land a
strike on
him, I've sensed a powerful
strength dwelling
within me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'll never forget how warmly he smiled,
or how
glad I felt hearing him praise my
technique.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
My next dream is to harness this
sensation to
reach yet unknown heights
in both my ability to
protect others...
and my ability to run.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Let your guard down, and I'll leave you
far behind
in my dust, Bamboo.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't have it any other way! But I'll
be right
there with you. No matter how
strong you get, I'm
aiming to be even
stronger!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That goes for me too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I want to bloom more magnificently than even the fullest bloom! I'll keep aiming for grander heights until I stand at the center of our generation!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wow, listen to you, Chiyono O! You've
been way
more fired up since you duked
it out with
Maruzen!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I have! How could I not be now that I'm
officially
her rival?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll never forget what it felt like when she
called
me her equal after our
no-holds-barred race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I made up my mind to keep
on
blooming beautifully, so that
Maruzen and I can
have even more
spectacular races in the future.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That's my new dream!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And if I want to shine even brighter than

Maruzen, then I can't let any of you beat
me!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You're so cool! I could learn something
from your
heartfelt passion!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I agree. As someone who has run
together with all
of you, I also hope that
we continue our rivalries.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ardan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
You're all so strong, passionate, and
blindingly
bright. You've inspired me to
follow your lead,
shine with my own
light, and challenge the
destiny that
awaits me.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You're racing Ramonu soon, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I still can't believe she acknowledged me
as a
worthy opponent and took the
trouble to
challenge me personally.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
But I think that's the best proof there is
that I,
Mejiro Ardan, have left a mark on
the world that
only I could.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
As such, my current dream is to surpass
the
brilliance of the Mejiro family's
crown jewel and
reach yet unknown
expanses.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: May we all realize our new dreams.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
We're the ultimate generation—we got
this in the
bag!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone is bursting with excitement to
fulfill
their new dreams! I can't let them
pass me by!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(Besides, I've got a new dream of my
own! I'm
gonna work with Trainer so that
I can turn the
heat up even higher!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: By the way...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whatever happened to your dream,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think back on a certain day some time
ago,
during a brief lull between Bamboo
Memory's
fiery races.

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
And now, the person you've all been
waiting for!
It's the Best Sprinter winner
herself—Bamboo
Memory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
EVERYONE! Thanks for coming to see
me today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, the racecourse is hosting an
event to
commemorate Bamboo
Memory's reception of the
URA award
for Best Sprinter.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Fan A
text_block_list.text: Congrats, Bamboo Memory!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for always doing your best!
Keep on
blazing ahead!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Bam-boo! Bam-boo! Bam-boo!
Bam-boo!
Bam-boo! Bam-boo!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
WHOOOAH! I can feel all the passion
and energy
in your voices! It's giving me
goosebumps!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've invited Bamboo Memory
and her
trainer to the stage, let's hear a
few words! First,
I'd like to ask...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Being surrounded by such an excited
audience
has Bamboo Memory
practically vibrating with
energy.
Together, we say a few words for her

many fans.

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
And now, the moment you've all been
waiting
for—we'd like to ask Bamboo
Memory to run a lap
to commemorate
this event!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I thought you'd never ask! Let's hurry up
and hit
the track!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You got it!
choice_data_list: It's only one lap, so let's give it everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'll be back in a flash!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory tears across the track
and the
audience roars with enthusiasm.
However, just as
she's about to reach the
end of her loop...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm not done yet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory crosses the finish line
but
doesn't slow down! Instead, she
keeps on running!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's this?! Bamboo Memory has
started a
second loop around the track!
choice_data_list: Just one lap is plenty, you hear me?!
Just one lap is plenty, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Keep it up, Bamboo Memory! There's
nothing like
watching you run!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo, you're so cool! I'll be your fan
forever
and ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though I'm shocked by Bamboo
Memory's
unexpected decision to keep
running, her fans
love it. And so, the
event ends as a great success.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On our way back after the event...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry I pulled that little stunt earlier!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... I just got so pumped up with
everyone
cheering for me, I let my
emotions get the better
of me...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I know they did, but still...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
choice_data_list: Everyone saw a "dream" in your running, Bamboo.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I looked toward the stands as she ran,
and it was
clear that every one of her
fans saw their very
own dreams reflected
in her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her showstopping performances and
drive to
change history lit up all of their
dreams as well.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Until now, I've always run toward my
own dreams.
I cheered everyone else on
as they chased their
dreams too, but...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If my fans have come to see their own
dreams
through me...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Then I couldn't be happier!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: What's your dream right now?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Is it still training me into a strong
Umamusume,
like you yelled at the
sunset back then?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to all of Bamboo Memory's
persistence
and hard work, she now
burns brightly as this
generation's best
sprinter and miler.
choice_data_list: ...That already came true a long time ago.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She really did make my dream come
true.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of races she's got in
store for
us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just like her fans, all the dreams I have
came
about because of Bamboo
Memory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In other words, I don't think I'd have any
dreams
at all if it weren't for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want to take on her dreams as my own,
and
continue to help her realize those
dreams.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Then I guess that means I have to keep
showing
you more dreams!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And not just you! I'll give all my fans and

everyone else in the world lots and lots
of
passionate dreams!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm Bamboo Memory—the best
of the
best...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And your dream!
